No name misdescribes its current behavior — test 16 added no new semantics, so no name drifted.

**Rules 1/3/4**: Tests pass (16/16). No duplication — the sphinx predicate and the type-counting knowledge each appear once. Fewest elements — every binding is referenced, and each of the three helpers is a distinct named concept from the spec rather than a speculative abstraction.

**APP mass**: unchanged at 41 (no code changed this cycle). Single conditional (mass 4) encoding the one branch the spec actually has; zero assignments, zero explicit loops. Collapsing any helper inline would leave mass flat while hiding the spec vocabulary, and Rule 2 trumps APP.
